Lead the design and development of high‑performance Web APIs, microservices, event‑driven components and agentic AI solutions. Mentor senior developers and guide teams in advanced engineering practices, design patterns, and system thinking. Ensure high‑quality delivery across the full SDLC, including design, development, testing, deployment, and observability. Collaboration & Influence Act as a trusted technical advisor to product, architecture, and leadership teams. Influence engineering culture, standards, and strategic technology decisions. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences. Lead by example, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement. Ability to design cloud‑native architectures with scalability, resilience, and security in mind. AI & Agentic Development Solid experience in prompt engineering, agentic AI SDLC pipelines and patterns. Ability to communicate AI concepts to executives, architects, and non‑technical teams, influencing organisational adoption and strategy. Experience with tools such as Copilot, Claude, Cursor, and frameworks like LangChain for building production‑grade AI systems. Leadership & Influence Recognised as a go‑to expert within your current organisation. Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and uplift team capability. Strong communication skills, able to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable insights. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field preferred. 10–14+ years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and expertise.
